sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:142

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:142:1
items.html: It would have been fitting not to call this Shema that is upon the bed until midnight: For in the first half of the night is the discernment of the return of ZA to his Katnut [smallness/infancy], in the secret of the bonds of sleep — meaning that he returns to the discernment of the nursing of the first two years, namely to the discernment of the NR [Nefesh-Ruach] of Ruach, which is called the internality of the Mochin of Katnut of Ima. And if so, that is not yet the time of the coupling for making a vessel; and this time begins only in the second half of the night, namely after midnight. And this is what he says: “it would have been fitting not to call this Shema that is upon the bed until midnight” — for then begins the time fit for the first intercourse. And this is what he says: “we recite the Shema before we sleep, for afterwards, at midnight, the coupling is made by means of our souls” — meaning, in this Shema we only make a preparation for the coupling that is made after midnight.
